notes.title: Update - v1.3.104
notes.notes:
We’ve Got an Update! This update introduces the festive "Christmas" skin, along with adjustments to volume settings and some bug fixes. 
We hope this update makes your gaming experience even smoother!

[h2][b]New Skin[/b][/h2]
[b][h3]Christmas[/h3][/b]
The festive "Christmas" skin is here! Dress up in the holiday spirit and enjoy the festive atmosphere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245671/c83d3da8106516e97efb64b4873facc4bad4bba3.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]
The maximum capacity for dots has been increased, so now you can store more of your overflowing dots!

[h2][b]Animations[/b][/h2]
The animation speed of the "Geometry" skin has been slightly increased for a smoother experience.

[h2][b]Music[/b][/h2]
Relaxing Background Music. We’ve added some relaxing background music. Initially, music wasn’t part of this desktop game’s design as we didn’t want to distract players. However, if you’d like to enjoy some calming tunes while playing, you can now turn on background music. If it feels distracting, you can always mute it.

[h2][b]Settings[/b][/h2]
New options for "Master Volume" and "Music Volume" have been added to the settings menu.

notes.title: Small update - v1.2.99
notes.notes:
We’ve released a small update aimed at improving the user experience in Desktop Blocks and fixing some known issues. We hope this update makes your gaming experience even smoother!

[h1][b]Setting[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] A new feature has been added in the settings to select the "monitor for the window." Now, with multiple monitors, you can move the window to another monitor.
[*] Added "Show Window Border" feature: [i][b]You can now find "Show Window Border" in the Settings menu[/b][/i]. With the window border enabled, you can freely drag the window around.
[/olist]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Hide Background" setting would not work in certain cases.
[/olist]

notes.title: Small update - v1.2.97
notes.notes:
We've brought a small update aimed at improving the user experience in Desktop Blocks and fixing a few known issues. We hope this update makes your gameplay smoother!

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the color saturation of the “Pop Art” skin to reduce visual strain and make colors softer. It’s now easier on the eyes!
[/olist]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added a new key function: [i][b]Press the V key to reset window settings[/b][/i]. Accidentally changed settings? No problem—pressing V will restore them to default so the kitties can spot the blocks on the screen again.
[*] Added a score display for block elimination to make clearing blocks feel more rewarding!
[*] Improved the menu layout to make each section clearer and easier to navigate.
[/olist]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where restoring window settings would sometimes not reset the game’s transparency correctly.
[/olist]

notes.title: Desktop Blocks will officially launch on November 7, 2024
notes.notes:
🎉 Exciting news ahead! 🎉

After a lively discussion and careful consideration among the cats, they have finally confirmed the launch date for [b]Desktop Blocks[/b]! 🐾✨

Thanks to the wisdom and inspiration of our furry friends, the game will officially launch on [u][b]November 7, 2024[/b][/u]! Let’s give a round of applause to these adorable kitties! 👏😺

Are you ready to embrace the challenge and enjoy the fun of the game? Just watch out for those kitties scratching the monitor!
